tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Search the catalog of components by text, category, subcategory, manufacturer and specification filters. Returns the total number of matches and, for each of the first results, the product id, name, manufacturer, category, key specifications and the URL of its profile.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: The full record of one product: manufacturer, category, every specification with its unit and the source page of each value, the date each was checked, and its profile URL.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: The record of one manufacturer: description, country, website, certifications and the list of its products with their ids and profile URLs.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The categories and subcategories of the catalog (ids and names, to use as filters in search_components), with the number of products of each.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare two to five products side by side, specification by specification: returns each product and, for every specification they state, the value of each one with its unit.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_components" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
